title: APE1 coordinates its disordered region and metal cofactors to drive genome surveillance.
authors: Lee, Donghun; Kim, Subin; Jo, Gyeongpil; Kim, Juwon; Yoo, Jungmin; Yoo, Jejoong; Lee, Ja Yil; Lee, Gwangrog
one_liner_zh: 该文结合单分子成像与分子动力学模拟，揭示APE1的N端无序区域(IDR)与金属辅因子协同驱动DNA损伤搜索的滑动机制，虽对象为DNA而非蛋白-蛋白互作(PPI)，但IDR介导的相互作用机制建模思路对无序蛋白互作研究有可迁移启发。
abstract: Efficient recognition of DNA lesions such as apurinic/apyrimidinic (AP) sites is essential for maintaining genome stability. Apurinic/apyrimidinic endonuclease 1 (APE1) is the primary eukaryotic AP endonuclease, yet how it identifies rare lesions among vast stretches of undamaged DNA remains incompletely understood. Using single-molecule imaging combined with molecular dynamics simulations, we reveal that APE1 employs a distinctive dual mechanism to search DNA damage. First, Mg2+ coordination at the active site neutralizes clustered negative charges, stabilizing electrostatic contacts during scanning. Second, its N-terminal intrinsically disordered region (IDR)-a feature conserved only in eukaryotic homologs but absent in prokaryotic ExoIII-not only interacts with DNA through transient IDR contacts but also engages continuous interactions via the unprecedented Arg177 residue within the structured nuclease domain, thereby prolonging residence time and enabling long-range diffusion. Together, these two modules synergize to promote a sliding-based search strategy tailored to the complexity of eukaryotic genomes. Consistent with this model, IDR deletion restricts APE1 to 3D collisions, whereas IDR duplication enhances 1D scanning. Thus, APE1 exemplifies how structural disorder and metal-ion coordination integrate to enable long-range lesion recognition, highlighting an evolutionary innovation in eukaryotic DNA repair.
abstract_zh: 对脱嘌呤/脱嘧啶（AP）位点等DNA损伤的高效识别对于维持基因组稳定性至关重要。脱嘌呤/脱嘧啶核酸内切酶1（APE1）是主要的真核AP核酸内切酶，然而它如何在大量未损伤DNA中识别稀有损伤的机制仍未完全阐明。通过结合单分子成像与分子动力学模拟，我们揭示APE1采用一种独特的双重机制来搜索DNA损伤。首先，活性位点的Mg2+配位中和了聚集的负电荷，稳定了扫描过程中的静电接触。其次，其N端 intrinsically disordered region (IDR)——这一特征仅在真核同源物中保守，而在原核ExoIII中缺失——不仅通过瞬时IDR接触与DNA相互作用，还通过结构化核酸酶结构域内前所未有的Arg177残基参与连续相互作用，从而延长驻留时间并实现长程扩散。这两个模块协同作用，促进了一种适应真核基因组复杂性的基于滑动的搜索策略。与该模型一致，IDR缺失将APE1限制为三维碰撞，而IDR重复则增强一维扫描。因此，APE1 exemplifies结构无序与金属离子配位如何整合以实现长程损伤识别，突显了真核DNA修复中的进化创新。
